name: second-look-extension
description: The reviewer's companion: ranks a pull request by what matters, so the human reviews it faster and better.

commands.title: Open part in the diff editor
Show only parts changed since your last look, or all parts

second-look.agent.description: The installed coding agent the companion drives for every agent pass of a review: Pi or Claude Code. The choice travels with each review request, so switching it and re-running a review needs no engine restart and stamps every agent-produced result with the new agent: the grouping pass always runs on it, and the ranking pass runs on it only where the agent, model and effort have an evaluation whose ranking matched or beat the plain one — each result's ranking says which ranking is shown and why. The status bar shows the agent in use, and choosing a combination the evaluation never tested shows a non-blocking warning. An agent that is missing, or a version too old for the companion's lockdown, is never run: the engine's agent probe reports what is missing.

second-look.agentModel.description: The model the selected agent runs for every agent pass of a review, in the agent's own naming: for example `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5` for Pi or `sonnet` for Claude Code. Empty uses the agent's own default model. The model is stamped on every agent-produced result, and the status bar shows the model in use. Choosing an agent, model and effort the companion's evaluation never tested shows a non-blocking warning naming the tested combinations; the current list is published as docs/tested-models.md in the repository.

second-look.agentEffort.description: The effort (thinking) level the selected agent runs at for every agent pass of a review, one of the levels the agent accepts: for example `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max` for Claude Code, or `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max` for Pi. Empty uses the agent's own default effort. The effort travels with each review request, so changing it needs no engine restart; it is stamped on every agent-produced result, and the status bar shows it beside the model, as the default effort when empty. Choosing an agent, model and effort the companion's evaluation never tested shows a non-blocking warning; the current list is published as docs/tested-models.md in the repository.

second-look.agentAccount.description: A label for the account or subscription the agent bills, such as `Claude Max (work address)` or `Pi personal key`, stamped on every agent-produced result of a review and shown in the status bar beside the agent, model and effort. The companion never reads the agent's login: this label is what you tell it. For Claude Code, the status bar warns when an inherited ANTHROPIC_API_KEY overrides the Claude subscription.

second-look.mirrorViewedToGitHub.description: Mirror the reviewed marks to GitHub's "Viewed" checkbox: once every part in a file is marked reviewed, the companion marks that whole file "Viewed" on the pull request, and never marks a file only partly reviewed or unmarks one. Off by default because the GitHub Pull Requests extension syncs the same field. The reviewed marks themselves are always kept locally, per pull request.

second-look.criteriaHeading.description: The heading the acceptance criteria checklist sits under in the issues a pull request links. The companion reads every task-list item under it — closing references, sidebar links and issues in other repositories alike — and lists each one in the overview, quoted and not checked until the agent maps it to the change. The heading travels with each review request, so changing it and re-running a review reads the new checklist; GitHub returns no closing references for a pull request into a non-default branch, and the overview says so.
